# ankra_applications (Data Source)

Lists the applications of the organisation (in the provider's project). The counterpart of `ankra application list`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "ankra_applications" "web" {
  search = "web"
}

output "application_ids" {
  value = [for application in data.ankra_applications.web.applications : application.id]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `search` (String) Only list applications whose name matches this text.

### Read-Only

- `applications` (Attributes List) Applications, newest first. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--applications))
- `id` (String) Placeholder identifier for the data source.

<a id="nestedatt--applications"></a>
### Nested Schema for `applications`

Read-Only:

- `app_repo_branch` (String) Branch Ankra builds and deploys.
- `app_repo_name` (String) Repository name.
- `app_repo_owner` (String) Repository owner.
- `app_repo_url` (String) Repository URL.
- `container_image_url` (String) Image repository the application's builds publish to.
- `created_at` (String) When the application was registered.
- `deployment_state` (String) Not reported by the listing; read one application with `ankra_application` for it.
- `id` (String) Identifier of the application.
- `name` (String) Application name.
- `pipeline_source` (String) What builds the application: an Ankra pipeline, the repository's own CI, or nothing yet.
- `state` (String) Lifecycle of the application record: `creating`, `up` or `error`.
